why.title: Hvorfor choose JPG over PNG for Vectors?
why.p1: Mens PNG understøtter gennemsigtighed, genererer JPG mindre filstørrelser til komplekse, farverige billeder.
list: Smaller Fils: Better for emails and attachments.
Ingen Transparency Issues: Nogle viewers render transparency as black. JPG forces a white background, ensuring your logo is legible.
